judge_summary: The extraction system correctly captured many core identity and numeric fields but missed or incorrectly extracted a significant number of fields including officer details, SMT entries 2, property fields, several yes/no flags (veteran, using_alcohol), and multiple agency/unit identifiers. OCR errors affected fields like afis_number, arr_officer_unit, occupation, and smt_1_description.

The extraction system achieved partial success, correctly capturing many identifier numbers, demographic fields, and some officer/transport information, but failed significantly on personal name fields (subject first/middle name confusion with emergency contact), boolean fields (drugs/alcohol/wanted all inverted), SMT details, arrest information, property items, and several key fields were entirely missing. The system also exhibited systematic field confusion where values were assigned to incorrect fields.

The extraction system performed moderately well on structured fields like IDs, addresses, and officer information, achieving exact matches on many of those. However, it made several critical errors including wrong first name (Eugene instead of Floyd), incorrect veteran and drug use flags, mixed-up phone numbers, missing key fields like date_of_birth, race, eyes, build, property items, and employer address, and several field-level confusions between prisoner and emergency contact data.

The extraction system achieved moderate performance, correctly capturing many identification numbers, arrest details, and officer information, but made several significant errors including wrong field mappings (phone numbers, middle names, city fields), missed fields (date_of_birth, race, glasses, property items), and OCR errors on names and agency. Critical data mix-ups such as phone number transpositions and wrong middle names reduce the overall reliability of the extraction.

The extraction system performed well on structured fields like names, numbers, and agency information, with most exact matches. However, it missed several fields entirely (race, date_of_birth, mustache, glasses, build, eyes, skin, property lists, phone_numbers_opportunity, religious_preference, address_source, employer_phone_type) and had notable errors including wrong dl_type ('J' vs 'C'), wrong phone_1_type ('Work' vs 'Cell'), wrong employer_source ('Google' vs 'Self'), and missing middle_name.
